q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said to Rafi, “May you achieve success.”
o: The teacher wished that Rafi might achieve success.
The teacher wished Rafi to achieved success.
The teacher prayed that Rafi may achieved success.
The teacher hoped that Rafi will achieve success.
e: "May you achieve success" শুভকামনা প্রকাশ করে, তাই indirect-এ said বদলে wished বসে। Quotation চিহ্নের জায়গায় that আসে, reporting verb past হওয়ায় may বদলে might হয়, আর you বদলে শ্রোতা Rafi নাম বসে। Might-এর পরে verb-এর মূল রূপ (achieve) থাকে। সঠিক রূপ: The teacher wished that Rafi might achieve success. Hoped-এর সঙ্গে will দিলে past-এর নিয়ম ভাঙে (would লাগত), আর achieved বা to achieved ব্যাকরণগতভাবে অশুদ্ধ।

q: Change into direct speech: “He asked me when the next letter would come.”
o: He said to me, “When would the next letter come?”
He asked to me, “When will the next letter come?”
He said to me, “When will the next letter come?”
He said to me, “When the next letter will come?”
e: Indirect-এর would direct-এ ফিরলে will হয়, কারণ reported speech-এর future (will) reporting verb past হলে would হয়েছিল। প্রশ্নের ক্রম ফিরে আসে: When will the next letter come? এরপর asked বদলে said to হয়। তাই “He said to me, ‘When will the next letter come?’” সঠিক। অন্য অপশনে would রয়ে গেছে, asked to me ভুল, আর শব্দক্রম বিবৃতির মতো।

q: Father said to me, "May you pass the examination." (Make it indirect)
o: Father prayed that I might be pased the examination.
Father hoped that I may pass the examination.
Father prayed that I might pass the examination.
Father said that might I pass the examination.
e: May you pass...-এর মতো প্রার্থনাসূচক optative বাক্যের indirect narration-এ reporting verb wish বা pray হয়, that বসে, তার পর new subject এবং may/might আসে। তাই Father prayed that I might pass the examination শুদ্ধ। বিকল্পে might I pass বা be pased-এর গঠন ভুল, আর hoped এখানে প্রার্থনার ভাব দেয় না।
